name: effect-fireworks
title: Fireworks with Trails
description: Một quả pháo bay lên, nổ thành 24 tia toả tròn, các hạt chậm dần, võng xuống theo trọng lực, kéo đuôi rồi tắt.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio pt-fireworks, written here): Rocket dot rises 100-700 ms easeOutQuad (~120 px). Burst at the top: 24 particles at 15 deg steps, distance 70 px x (1 - e^(-2.5 t)), gravity sag 20 px x t^2, each with 5 trail copies 40 ms behind (opacity 1 - k/5, shrinking); fade over 1-2 s after the burst; 2 alternating colours. Params: count (24) · radius (70 px) · trail (5) · colors.
